The predictive-coding model (Kilner, Friston, & Frith, 2007) is based on the conception of a hierarchy of reciprocally connected models. Each model generates predictions about the representations at the immediately subordinate level. title: Checking Statistical Reporting
text: Journal Article Reporting Standards (JARS) developed American Psychological Association provide guidance information reported scientific articles support transparency reproducibility [@appelbaum2018]. Almost every published article improve researchers diligently followed JARS, guidelines widely known, rarely enforced journals, time-consuming check manually. Automation can help. Metacheck provides five modules checking statistical reporting quality. vignette demonstrates one using papers psychsci built-dataset — 250 open-access articles published Psychological Science 2004 2014. modules return list $traffic_light (“green”, “yellow”, “red”, “na”), $summary_text, $table detailed results.

title: Checking Statistical Reporting
text: APA Manual states: Report exact p values (e.g., p = .031) two three decimal places. However, report p values less .001 p < .001.
